title: Lightly Flaky Vietnamese Comte Noodles
description: A malty and flaky Vietnamese dish featuring comte cheese, perfect for a cozy meal, with low glycemic ingredients for a healthier option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the score fat over medium heat.
Add the grated comte cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and lightly browned.
Add the malt syrup, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the comte cheese mixture.
Stir in the toasted sesame oil and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and top with chopped scallions.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
